Time-series route; naive, seasonal naive and ARIMA or ETS references
Reclassify to time series when reference residuals show strong autocorrelation

route.reason: Forward development Ridge D7 leaves strong residual dependence; explicit RT1 rule applies

evidence.interpretation: Exploratory diagnostics; overlap, changing monthly fits and small samples limit asymptotic calibration; no proof of causal usefulness of a new feature

preserved_E1_contract.deep_learning_inputs: seven closed UTC daily OHLCV bars; D7x5
preserved_E1_contract.target: population standard deviation of seven consecutive daily log returns, ddof=0, not annualized
preserved_E1_contract.primary_metric: mean over seeds of per-trajectory RMSE in original sigma units
preserved_E1_contract.evaluation_scope: already observed historical calendar; exploratory; no new test seal

benchmark_panel.status: updated design, not executed or declared ready by route resolution
benchmark_panel.common_eligible_calendar: intersection of explicitly valid outcome/input/reference supports; no calendar compression or post-result exclusions

seasonal_naive_lag7.seasonality_claim: registered weekly calendar comparator; no significant weekly seasonality inferred from STL or results

ARIMA.parameter_fit_cutoff: no later than first_outer_origin-8 calendar days
ARIMA.target_scaling: training-only mean; exactly 1 for an all-zero training series
ARIMA.local_candidate_orders: p in {0,1,2}, d in {0,1}, q in {0,1}; 12 configurations
ARIMA.trend: constant when d=0; no deterministic trend when d=1
ARIMA.policy: one parameter fit per registered outer origin; fixed parameters afterwards; daily state update through t-1 only, refit=False
ARIMA.missing_label_policy: NaN at the true day in the state-space observation sequence; never compress/interpolate; missing latest label makes forecast ineligible
ARIMA.information_support: all eligible past labels from declared training start through t-1; longer and endogenous relative to D7x5 DL
ARIMA.nonconvergence_policy: explicit failed candidate; no silent alternative fitted or test-based replacement
ARIMA.benchmark_postprocessing: benchmark_nonnegative: max(0,raw_forecast), fixed before results; retain raw_value and failure status
